policy.purpose: Known-good cost/quality baseline for future qualification experiments.
policy.mutation: Do not change baseline evidence, prompts, model assignments, or artifacts in-place. New model experiments must use separate qualification files/workflows.

canonical_success_cost.note: Successful canonical calls only; excludes failed experimental attempts.

quality_notes: Known Turkish naturalness issues are product-language quality findings for future locale polish work and do not mutate this frozen baseline.
